related.title: 超導讀出時序：共振器光子排空
related.titleEn: Superconducting readout timing: resonator photon depletion
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付單線／束線熱表、錨點剖面與k(T)資料需求。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver wire/bundle heat tables, anchor cross-sections and required k(T) data. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『超導讀出時序：共振器光子排空』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付光子／場振幅雙公式、排空曲線與時間窗驗收。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Superconducting readout timing: resonator photon depletion', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver separate photon/field laws, depletion curves and timing-window acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：常數平均導熱率代理Q=kAΔT/L；真實低溫材料需積分k(T)，此處只做尺寸敏感度。 使用合成平均k=0.02 W/(m·K)、A=10⁻⁸ m²、ΔT=3.9 K、L=0.2 m。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.02*1e-8*3.9/0.2*1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：核對Q×L不變；再將100根相同配線加總，避免把單根結果誤當整束。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：能量／光子數n(t)=n0 exp(−κt)；場振幅則以κ/2衰減，兩者不可混用。 使用合成κ=2π×2 MHz、n0=10、等待t=200 ns。 以手算或試算表計算名義式10*exp(-2*pi*2e6*200e-9)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以兩次200 ns衰減因子相乘重現400 ns結果；若誤用場振幅式將高估殘留。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Constant mean-conductivity proxy Q=kAΔT/L; real cryogenic materials require integrating k(T), so this exercise only studies geometric sensitivity. Use Synthetic mean k=0.02 W/(m·K), A=10⁻⁸ m², ΔT=3.9 K and L=0.2 m. Evaluate nominal expression 0.02*1e-8*3.9/0.2*1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Verify invariant Q×L; sum100 identical wires separately so per-wire heat is not mistaken for bundle heat.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Energy/photon number n(t)=n0 exp(−κt); field amplitude decays atκ/2, so do not mix them. Use Synthetic κ=2π×2 MHz, n0=10 and wait t=200 ns. Evaluate nominal expression 10*exp(-2*pi*2e6*200e-9) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Multiply two200 ns decay factors to reproduce400 ns; using the field-amplitude law overestimates remaining photons.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NIST 囚禁離子：紅藍邊帶溫度計
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付單線／束線熱表、錨點剖面與k(T)資料需求。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。

related.difference: 建立『NIST 囚禁離子：紅藍邊帶溫度計』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付邊帶積分表、非線性反算曲線及有效域標記。

related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：常數平均導熱率代理Q=kAΔT/L；真實低溫材料需積分k(T)，此處只做尺寸敏感度。 使用合成平均k=0.02 W/(m·K)、A=10⁻⁸ m²、ΔT=3.9 K、L=0.2 m。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.02*1e-8*3.9/0.2*1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：核對Q×L不變；再將100根相同配線加總，避免把單根結果誤當整束。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：熱分布且弱探測時紅藍邊帶比R=Ired/Iblue=n̄/(n̄+1)，所以n̄=R/(1−R)。 使用合成積分紅邊帶0.2、藍邊帶1.0，R=0.2；先不加入飽和效應。 以手算或試算表計算名義式0.2/(1-0.2)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：反算R=n̄/(n̄+1)還原兩比例；把R=1列為發散界線，R>1不是有效熱平衡解。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Constant mean-conductivity proxy Q=kAΔT/L; real cryogenic materials require integrating k(T), so this exercise only studies geometric sensitivity. Use Synthetic mean k=0.02 W/(m·K), A=10⁻⁸ m², ΔT=3.9 K and L=0.2 m. Evaluate nominal expression 0.02*1e-8*3.9/0.2*1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Verify invariant Q×L; sum100 identical wires separately so per-wire heat is not mistaken for bundle heat.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For a thermal distribution under weak probing, red/blue ratio R=n̄/(n̄+1), hence n̄=R/(1−R). Use Synthetic integrated red sideband0.2 and blue1.0 give R=0.2; saturation is initially excluded. Evaluate nominal expression 0.2/(1-0.2) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Invert R=n̄/(n̄+1) for both cases; R=1 is divergent and R>1 is not a valid thermal solution.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
